services.name: Tampa Bay Tour
services.desc: Experience Tampa Bay's oldest park on our exhilarating Philippe Park E-Bike Tour! Glide through 92 acres of majestic oak-canopied trails while discovering the rich history of this National Historic Landmark, established in 1842 by Count Odet Philippe, who introduced grapefruit to Florida. Marvel at the impressive Tocobaga Indian temple mound, one of the largest surviving Native American ceremonial sites in the Tampa Bay region. Our expert guides will share fascinating stories about the indigenous people who thrived here since 900 A.D. and the French settler who saved his family during a hurricane by seeking refuge atop this very mound.
